goal: Export the <daily> report & publish it to the "metrics" bucket.
success_criteria: The report is exported with every required field.
Publishing the same report twice is idempotent.
context: The pipeline runs on a nightly schedule.
constraints: Do not change the bucket layout.
edge_cases: An empty CSV produces an explicit error.

output_contract.notes: Start with the result; avoid `generic` intros.

blocking_questions: Which timezone should the report use?
validation_checks: Run the export twice and compare the outputs.
